process_area.title: Cooperative Purchase Order, Logistics & Livelihood Settlement

fields.Participants: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Buyer (links to VS-03), Inventory Planning, Coop Representatives
fields.Trigger: Demand plan (links to VS-02); coop production cycle; new SKU introduction

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-communication of "communicated in coop's preferred language/channel and acknowledged" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "System reserves commitment against capacity-building / advance-financing facility if" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-512 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Purchase Order, Logistics & Livelihood Settlement (PA-94.2).)
- operational: minimum-offtake commitment (W3116) and demand smoothing
Pain Points / Risks: - **Demand-volatility risk**: Sudden de-stocking strands coop inventory; mitigated by minimum-offtake commitment (W3116) and demand smoothing
System Touchpoints: - Demand planning (links to VS-02); PO placement (links to VS-03); impact tagging (links to W3129)

steps.activity: Inventory Planning/Sustainability Sourcing Mgr aggregate demand across stores for coop-sourced SKUs (links to VS-02); respect coop production capacity, minimum viable batch, and lead time; smooth demand to fit coop labor

Buyer/Sustainability Sourcing Mgr place PO (links to VS-03) with contract pricing (W3116), delivery window aligned to coop cycle (W3123), and clear spec reference (W3118); PO communicated in coop's preferred language/channel and acknowledged
System reserves commitment against capacity-building / advance-financing facility if applicable (links to W3127); flag PO as coop-sourced for impact tracking (links to W3129)

fields.Participants: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Coop Representatives, Quality, Logistics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-submit of "submit weekly progress" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews progress vs." (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "inspection if applicable" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-68 (ensure cooperative vendor qualification & settlement integrity.)
- operational: simple mobile/SMS-based reporting and periodic on-site visit
Pain Points / Risks: - **Visibility risk**: Manual progress reporting is unreliable; mitigated by simple mobile/SMS-based reporting and periodic on-site visit
System Touchpoints: - PO/production tracker; demand/supply re-plan (links to VS-02)

steps.activity: Coop Representatives submit weekly progress: units produced, on-hand raw material, in-process, expected completion, any blockers (weather, labor, material supply, equipment)
Sustainability Sourcing Mgr reviews progress vs. plan; for at-risk POs: re-plan with coop, expedite, partial-ship approval, or communicate revised delivery to Planning (links to VS-02) and stores
Quality performs in-line (in-process) inspection if applicable; corrective action before shipment to reduce rejects at receipt (links to W3125)

fields.Participants: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Category (links to VS-01/VS-64), Inventory Planning, Coop Representatives
fields.Trigger: Annual seasonal planning; agricultural harvest cycle; festival/religious calendar

workflows.name: Cooperative Harvest / Production Cycle & Seasonal Calendar Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document constraint windows" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-communication of "communicates confirmed seasonal PO plan to coops with adequate lead time" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-512 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Purchase Order, Logistics & Livelihood Settlement (PA-94.2).)
- operational: joint planning and forward-stock buffer
Pain Points / Risks: - **Calendar-mismatch risk**: Promotional demand out of sync with coop cycle; mitigated by joint planning and forward-stock buffer
System Touchpoints: - Seasonal calendar master (links to VS-01/VS-64); demand plan (links to VS-02)

steps.activity: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr/Coop map each coop's production/harvest calendar: agricultural harvest (garden/plants), festival-driven handicraft (Christmas/baskets), rainy-season limitations, religious/community feasts; document constraint windows

Category/Planning (links to VS-01/VS-64) align BuildRight promotional/seasonal plan to coop capacity: pre-position ahead of coop downtimes; avoid peak-demand during coop capacity troughs; plan forward stock (links to VS-64)

Sustainability Sourcing Mgr communicates confirmed seasonal PO plan to coops with adequate lead time; manage exceptions (force-majeure weather — typhoon links to VS-69; raw-material shortage) with planning

fields.Participants: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Logistics (links to VS-06), 3PL (links to VS-56), Coop Representatives
fields.Volume: Often small-parcel / LTL from remote coop locations

workflows.name: Cooperative Inbound Logistics, Consolidation & Last-Mile Pickup

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics plans most-economical mode" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "For remote barangay pickups" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track in-transit to BuildRight DC" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-512 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Purchase Order, Logistics & Livelihood Settlement (PA-94.2).)
- operational: consolidation, backhaul optimization, and DC pickup window flexibility
Pain Points / Risks: - **Rural-logistics risk**: High cost and unreliable pickup from remote coops; mitigated by consolidation, backhaul optimization, and DC pickup window flexibility
System Touchpoints: - TMS / 3PL dispatch (links to VS-06/VS-56); permits (links to VS-22/VS-87); in-transit visibility

steps.activity: Coop notifies ready-for-shipment with quantity, packaging, dimensions, weight, pickup location; Logistics plans most-economical mode: 3PL small-parcel (links to VS-56), own-fleet backhaul (links to VS-06), or consolidation with nearby coops

For remote barangay pickups: arrange last-mile collection (motorcycle/tricycle to consolidation point, then truck); document chain-of-custody; address rural infrastructure limits (road condition, typhoon disruption — links to VS-69)

Logistics/Coop handle export/import-equivalent paperwork if crossing regions or with indigenous products (CITES-equivalent, DENR permits for plant/forest materials — links to VS-22/VS-87); track in-transit to BuildRight DC

fields.Participants: DC Receiving (links to VS-04), Quality, Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Finance
fields.Trigger: Coop shipment arrives at BuildRight DC

workflows.name: Cooperative Goods Receipt, Quality Inspection & Acceptance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "check" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documented evidence and photos" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "discount" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-68 (ensure cooperative vendor qualification & settlement integrity.)
- operational: AQL partial-accept, rework path, and root-cause capacity-building (W3117)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reject-impact risk**: Rejecting a whole coop batch harms dependent community; mitigated by AQL partial-accept, rework path, and root-cause capacity-building (W3117)
System Touchpoints: - Receiving/GR (links to VS-04); quality inspection (links to VS-31); inventory putaway (links to VS-05); AP (links to VS-15)

steps.activity: DC Receiving (links to VS-04 W3) receives coop shipment: ASN/PO match, count verification, condition check (damage in transit), special handling for fragile/handicraft/agricultural; flag for quality inspection

Quality performs AQL inspection per spec (W3118): dimensions, materials, finish, packaging/labeling, lot/traceability; classify defects; accept / partial-reject / reject with documented evidence and photos

For accept: putaway to inventory (links to VS-05); for partial-reject: notify coop, agree disposition (rework/credit/discount); for reject: hold, document, file quality claim (W3128); post to AP for settlement (W3126)

fields.Participants: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, AP (links to VS-15), Finance, Treasury (links to VS-18), Coop Representatives

workflows.name: Cooperative Invoice, Livelihood Settlement & Direct-to-Account Pay

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validate fair-trade price compliance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Sustainability Sourcing Mgr/Finance execute direct-to-coop-account settlement" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "record in AP subledger and impact tracker" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-68 (ensure cooperative vendor qualification & settlement integrity.)
- operational: mandatory direct-to-bank and expedited terms; operational: direct-to-bank and expedited terms
Pain Points / Risks: - **Payment-friction risk**: Cheque/cash payment to rural coop causes delay/loss; mitigated by mandatory direct-to-bank and expedited terms
System Touchpoints: - AP 3-way match (links to VS-15); bank transfer / direct pay (links to VS-18); impact tracker (links to W3129)

steps.activity: Coop submits invoice per accepted quantity at contract price (W3116); AP performs match: PO → GR (W3125) → Invoice, with adjustment for any partial-reject/short-ship; validate fair-trade price compliance

Sustainability Sourcing Mgr/Finance execute direct-to-coop-account settlement: payment to coop's CDA-registered bank account; for indigenous/artisanal work, consider direct-to-beneficiary split per contract; favor faster terms than mainstream (e.g., net 15 vs. net 30)
Treasury (links to VS-18) process payment via bank transfer (not cheque — rural banking friction); confirm receipt with coop; record in AP subledger and impact tracker (links to W3129)

fields.Frequency: Per PO advance (~30–60% of PO value)
fields.Participants: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Finance, Treasury (links to VS-18), Legal, Coop Representatives
fields.Trigger: Coop cash-flow need for raw material/labor; advance per contract (W3116)

workflows.name: Cooperative Advance Financing & Working Capital Support

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates against production plan" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "record as advance/accrued against PO" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracking" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-512 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Purchase Order, Logistics & Livelihood Settlement (PA-94.2).)
- operational: capped advance %, set-off mechanism, and capacity-assessed onboarding (W3115)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-recovery risk**: Coop fails to deliver after advance; mitigated by capped advance %, set-off mechanism, and capacity-assessed onboarding (W3115)
System Touchpoints: - AP advance accrual (links to VS-15); treasury disbursement (links to VS-18); impact tracker (links to W3129)

steps.activity: Coop requests advance per contract terms; Sustainability Sourcing Mgr validates against production plan (W3122) and contract; prevent over-advance by netting against open POs
Finance/Treasury disburse advance via direct-to-coop-account (links to VS-18); record as advance/accrued against PO; Legal confirms advance terms (repayment via set-off on final invoice)
At settlement (W3126): AP nets advance from final payment; reconcile to zero; report advance utilization for impact tracking (links to W3129) and capacity-building program (W3117)

fields.Participants: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr, Quality, AP (links to VS-15), Coop Representatives, Legal
fields.Trigger: Quality reject, short-ship, damage-in-transit, invoice discrepancy

workflows.name: Cooperative Dispute, Short-Shipment & Quality Claim Resolution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "record — W3125, invoice" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "file claim with carrier/3PL" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "AP/Finance process credit/replacement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-512 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Purchase Order, Logistics & Livelihood Settlement (PA-94.2).)
- operational: fair-trade duty-of-care and root-cause approach
Pain Points / Risks: - **Erosion-of-trust risk**: Aggressive claim posture damages coop partnership; mitigated by fair-trade duty-of-care and root-cause approach
System Touchpoints: - Dispute/claim register; AP credit (links to VS-15); carrier claim (links to VS-90); capacity tracker (links to W3117)

steps.activity: Sustainability Sourcing Mgr documents dispute: evidence (photos, GR record — W3125, invoice), categorize (quality/quantity/damage/invoice), proposed remedy (rework, replacement, credit, price adjustment)

Engage Coop Representatives with respectful, capacity-building framing (root-cause rather than punitive); agree remedy and timeline; for damage-in-transit, file claim with carrier/3PL (links to VS-56/VS-90)
AP/Finance process credit/replacement; track systemic disputes to drive capacity-building (W3117); for repeat offenders, escalate to offboarding review (W3120); document resolution
steps.r: AP Clerk / Finance / Sustainability Sourcing Mgr
